summary: RPCS3 Core 624 = the delivered Core 610 plus one folded delta: the Core 612, 613, 616, 619 and 621 records unchanged and the Core 624 changes (build-utils/rpcs3/core624-from-621.patch over the Core 621 delivered in IPA 622), from the Build 622 iPhone logs: with the ZCULL on-demand lever (Assassin's Creed, Black Ops II) the RSX reports block is placed so that its report array starts on a host page, so GCM label and notify reads never share a page with a report ZCULL holds locked (Assassin's Creed: 411 of 444 faults in a window were label reads, the lever tripped and the upstream mode then blocked the RSX thread 4.1-4.3 s per 5 s; REWINDBOX_ZCULL_LABEL_PAGE_624); a conditional render whose query is still on the GPU and whose report already shows the object visible draws without waiting (Black Ops II multiplayer: 0.9-1.2 s of RSX waits per 5 s; REWINDBOX_ZCULL_COND_PREVIOUS_624); COREPROF ZCULL624 counts both and the thread class of the on-demand faults (REWINDBOX_ZCULL_FAULT_CENSUS_624). ABI 30, the 92 exports, the PPU/SPU codegen identities (no codegen input changes) and the MoltenVK dependency of Core 610 unchanged. Numbered 624: IPA 623 is another session's MeloNX build.

route.note: The route keeps its Core 610 file names (workflow, gate, driver, recipe patch, core610-proof.json, core610-recipe.sh): the frozen recipe patch and the driver pins name the gate path, so the executed recipe stays byte-identical to the one Core 610 executed. Every per-build value is declared here.
